<title level="1" right="Class Feature 1">[Reactive Strike](/Classes.aspx?ID=35)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 136

**Class** Fighter
</column>

---

Ever watchful for weaknesses, you can quickly attack foes that leave an opening in their defenses. You gain the Reactive Strike reaction.
